overclaims: The benchmark uses tasks derived from known vulnerabilities, so its percentages must not be generalized to all generated code.
checks.note: The excerpt, proposition, axis, outcome and citations all match. The 84.4% and 7.8% figures are paired correctly to Cursor with Opus 4.6. However, the first limitation says the benchmark uses tasks derived from known vulnerabilities. No evidence item says this: e1 mentions only real-world open-source code and vulnerability classes. Minor issue: the rationale says '84.4% of tasks', while the source says 84.4% of generated code passed functional tests (functional correctness). Fix: remove or reword the first limitation and match the source wording.
